findings.summary: Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:18 accepts a path beginning with services/api under root services/api, including services/api-evil/config.py; it also performs no normalization checks.
findings.summary: Paths and roots are not validated, and raw prefix matching can authorize paths outside a root.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:18 reads only change["path"], so an out-of-scope from_path can be renamed into scope.
release_policy.py:17-19 ignores action, returns True for empty changes even when roots are empty, and indexes change["path"] without validation.
findings.summary: Unknown actions and an empty root set are not rejected consistently, and malformed records can raise instead of returning False.
